item.text:
**5B.7, 2024: mostly no**
Putin showed a few narrow technocratic and corrective moves, but the dominant pattern was secrecy, scapegoating, war-driven distortion, and patronage rather than sustained evidence-based correction.

| Stance | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | Decree of the President of the Russian Federation of 15 February 2024 No. 124 | President of Russia | 2024-02-15 | https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50326/print | Amends the AI strategy to expand compute access, datasets, open libraries, resilient networks, and training. This is real technical policy design, though still state-directed and narrow. | 5B.7, 5B.6 |
| Support | Russian central bank keeps rates on hold after Putin's call for 'balance' | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135 | Putin publicly backed the central bank’s tight policy instead of overruling it, and the bank said earlier tightening had created conditions for disinflation. This is weak but real evidence of deference to expert judgment. | 5B.7, 5B.6 |
| Support | Two more Russian officials arrested in widening military corruption probe | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-23 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/two-more-russian-officials-arrested-in-widening-military-corruption-probe-3454644 | Reuters reported a widening bribery probe with five defense officials detained in a month. That is limited evidence of responding to corruption in a spending-heavy sector, not a broad reform of economic governance. | 5B.7, 5B.5 |
| Against | Putin lets 'economically significant' entities limit information disclosures | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001 | Widened secrecy for major firms reduced public scrutiny and made policy less transparent, which cuts against evidence-based correction. | 5B.7, 5B.4, 5B.5 |
| Against | Putin says Russia's economy is overheating, inflation is worrying | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-12-19 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Putin-says-Russia-s-economy-is-overheating-inflation-is-worrying-48625233/ | Putin admitted overheating and inflation pressure, but the Reuters report says he blamed Western sanctions and a bad harvest for high inflation. That mixes partial acknowledgment with scapegoating. | 5B.7, 5B.6 |
| Against | Analysis: Russia's GDP boost on military spending belies wider economic woes | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-02-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisrussias-gdp-boost-on-military-spending-belies-wider-economic-woes-3295688 | Growth was powered by state arms production and masked broader civilian weakness, suggesting war mobilization rather than evidence-led productivity policy. | 5B.7, 5B.6 |
| Against | Russia braces for more tax rises to fund the Ukraine war | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-31 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisrussia-braces-for-more-tax-rises-to-fund-the-ukraine-war-3693480 | Economists expected more tax rises to finance ballooning military spending, which looks like extraction for war rather than correction toward broad prosperity. | 5B.7, 5B.6 |
| Against | Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Says corruption is pervasive, elites get contracts and protection for loyalty, and decision-making is opaque. This is strong background evidence for patronage and closed, non-corrective governance. | 5B.7, 5B.5 |

Search gap: I did not find a clear 2024 example where Putin publicly identified a specific economic-policy mistake, reversed course because the evidence changed, and explained the correction as such. The strongest pro evidence is indirect, centered on deference to the central bank and narrow technocratic planning; the stronger negative evidence is repeated and explicit.
